data.gender_notes: Leonanie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek leon, meaning 'lion'. The name Leonanie evokes the strength and courage of a lioness. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the Lion of Judah and the power of God. The name Leonanie carries the meaning “Lioness, strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Leonanie usually hope their child will grow to embody lioness, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Leonanie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lioness, strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leonanie total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
celebrity_usage: Leonanie Blair-Bentall, British-Grenadian author and broadcaster
data.cultural_impact: Leonanie carries the spirit and strength of a lion, a powerful and majestic animal. In many cultures, the lion represents courage, royalty, and power, making this name a fitting choice for someone who embodies these qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Leonanie is associated with the Lion of Judah, a symbol of Jesus Christ. This name reminds us of the power and strength of God, and the courage and bravery that follows in His footsteps. It is a name that invites us to be strong in our faith and to trust in God's protection and guidance, just as a lioness protects and cares for her cubs.
